_meta.title: AMC Budget Timeseries — AMTS, Libraries & Civic Lines
_meta.page_convention: page = PDF/print PAGE marker from pypdf extraction (1-based physical page). AMC's own 'Page X of N' internal number is ~30-35 lower; both noted where used.
_meta.units: amount_cr is normalised to Rupees CRORE. 'raw' preserves the exact figure + unit string from the PDF. AMC mixes crore (narrative/resolutions) and lakh (budget-code tables); 1 crore = 100 lakh.
_meta.estimate_basis: AMC budget tables carry multiple columns: prior-year ACTUAL, current-year REVISED ESTIMATE (RE), and budget-year BUDGET ESTIMATE (BE). Each row's 'account_head' / note records which basis the figure is. The self-labelled narrative 'For X total Rs. A is expected to be spent in [prior FY] while Rs. B has been allocated in [budget FY]' is the most legible anchor and is preferred for the headline BE.
caveats: AMTS 'Loan to AMTS' is a capital LOAN/grant-support line from the corporation fund to the transport undertaking; it is NOT the AMTS operating deficit. The AMTS operating deficit anchor (~Rs.200 cr/yr per the Drive FY23-24 summary) is a separate operational figure not isolated as a single line in these capital blocks.

Library: AMC does not publish a single consolidated 'all libraries' budget head in the English PDF. The legible, citable library figure is the 'Grant for Sheth M.J. Library' resolution, which states (a) the library committee's TOTAL decided grant, (b) the commissioner's BASE allocation, and (c) the AMC ADDITIONAL top-up. Branch/ward libraries appear only as scattered one-off capital works (Rs.0.85-10.5 cr each), not a recurring head, so a true 'total library portfolio' is a reconstruction (Drive doc put FY23-24 portfolio ~Rs.33.5 cr; NOT independently re-derived here).

School Board: AMC's own contribution is the 'additional grant for primary education' resolution (the AMC top-up OVER the state government grant). The full school-board budget (Rs.671 cr in 2018-19 rising to Rs.1071 cr in 2023-24) is mostly state-funded; the AMC-controlled top-up is the politically attributable line and is recorded as account_head 'amc_additional_top_up'.

Code-table rows (e.g. '711 A.M.T.S.', '601 PARKS AND GARDENS') extract with mangled multi-row headers; their 7 numbers could not be column-labelled with certainty from text alone, so they are recorded at LOW confidence as cross-checks only, not as the headline figure.
2021-22 has NO standalone PDF; its ACTUAL/RE figures are recovered from the 2022-23 PDF's prior-year columns (confidence medium, basis=actual/RE not BE).

missing_years.site_status: ahmedabadcity.gov.in returns HTTP 200 (NOT IP-gated as of 2026-06-04). However the budget-listing page is a JS-rendered SPA; static curl of the homepage exposes no budget PDF hrefs, and blind probing of guessed document paths (AMCWEBSITE/Documents/Budget/..., Pages/Budget.aspx, jsp routes) returns 404/302. The existing PDFs carry CMS download-id suffixes (e.g. ...English9026.pdf) that are not derivable without the document-API listing.
missing_years.note: No fabrication: these years were NOT downloaded. They require either (a) the AMC SPA document-API call / manual browser download, or (b) WebFetch/WebSearch which needs explicit user permission. 2021-22 spend figures ARE partially recoverable from the 2022-23 PDF's prior-year columns (captured above for AMTS=341, AJL=90, Riverfront=84).
